name: Upstash Redis Free
free_limit: One Free Upstash Redis database: 256 MB data, 500,000 commands/month and 10 GB monthly bandwidth
watch_out: Instant databases created without signup are deleted after 3 days unless claimed in an account. The claimed Free tier has ongoing monthly quotas; entering a credit card upgrades the database to Pay-as-you-go pricing, whose usage is charged separately.
